title: One local check command for Cyclotron, run by release_to_main.sh
description:
Standing rule: CI for private repos runs locally (no GitHub Actions minutes). Run the full gate locally before merging. Today make test runs pytest only (12 minutes locally, see the suite-speed issue); the trace-ui suite (cd trace-ui && npm test, 263 tests) and the trace-ui build are separate targets that nothing runs before a merge, and a fresh npm run build rewrites src/decision_flywheel/vendor/trace-ui/web.css, viewer.css and web.js, meaning the committed bundle that pip installs is stale against the source.
Do: add a make check target that runs, in order: ruff (once the lint issue lands), python -m pytest, cd trace-ui && npm ci && npm test && npm run build, then git diff --exit-code src/decision_flywheel/vendor/trace-ui to catch bundle drift. Make scripts/dev/release_to_main.sh run make check instead of the test suite alone. Document make check in docs/dev-procedures.md as the gate. Keep .github/workflows/release.yml for the semantic-release job but do not rely on its test job.
Done when: make check passes on develop with a fresh trace-ui build committed, release_to_main.sh calls it, and dev-procedures.md says so. Review doc: https://claude.ai/code/artifact/dcd5a089-28f1-4a3f-9f2f-a293789709c0 (Cyclotron review, 2026-10-17).
